name: Fury
info: Increase HP by 5. Equip Martial Melee and Armor.

data.name: Adrenaline
data.description: As long as you are in `Crisis`, you deal`【SL × 2】`extra damage (be it with attacks, spells, Arcana, items or any other method).

data.name: Frenzy
data.description: Your Accuracy Checks with `brawling`, `dagger`, `flail` and `thrown` weapons trigger a `critical success` if both dice show the same number (and the Check is not a `fumble`).

data.name: Frenzy (Unarmed)
data.description:
*This variant provides the Fury Class with a way to improve Accuracy on fast-attacking weapons, and introduces a core book option for **unarmed strikes** that does not create problematic stacking with effects such as **Empty Hands** or **Akromorphosis**.*

You gain a bonus equal to`【SL】`to your Accuracy Checks with `brawling`, `dagger`, `flail`, and `thrown` weapons. Your `unarmed strikes` deal extra damage equal to`【4 + (SL × 2) + (your level, divided by 5)】`, and cannot benefit from any source of extra damage other than this Skill and the `Adrenaline` Skill (above).

data.name: Meteor Slam
data.description:
*This variant replaces Frenzy with the option to dish out a staggering and accurate hit that leaves enemies reeling for a brief time.*

You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform a `free attack` with a weapon you have equipped. This attack gains a bonus equal to`【SL】`to its Accuracy Check, and if you are using a `brawling`, `dagger`, `flail`, or `thrown` weapon, it also deals`【SL × 2】`extra damage. Every enemy that loses Hit Points due to this attack cannot perform `free attacks` nor the `Guard` action until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Indomidable Spirit
data.description: When you spend one or more Fabula Points, you get an additional benefit — choose one option: you recover`【SL × 5】`Hit Points; or you recover`【SL × 5】`Mind Points; `or` you recover from a single status effect of your choice.

data.name: Provoke
data.description:
You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform an Opposed`【MIG + WLP】`Check against an enemy you can see — describe how you taunt them! If you succeed, the target suffers `enraged`, is compelled to focus their attention on you, and must include you among the targets of their attacks and offensive spells (*ϟ*) if able. This compulsion ends if you fall unconscious or leave the scene, if the creature is no longer `enraged`, or if they are successfully `provoked` by someone else.

You gain a bonus equal to`【SL】`to your`【MIG + WLP】`Checks for this Skill.

data.name: Withstand
data.description: When you perform the `Guard` action, if you choose `not` to provide cover to another creature, you recover Hit Points equal to`【5 + (SL, multiplied by the highest strength among your Bonds)】`and choose `Might` or `Willpower`: you treat the chosen Attribute as being one die size higher (up to a maximum of `d12`) until the end of your next turn.
